available.description: Grid-wide IPcs remaining in the shared pool. Same value on every row. total - sum(allocated across all types), clamped at 0.

last_updated_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the last IPc stats refresh, as an ISO 8601 string.

total.description: Grid-wide licensed IPc capacity. Same value on every row. Zero for air-gapped grids with no TAB imported.

add_on_service.description: Comma-separated list of add-on services enabled on the member (e.g. "ADP, DCA, TI"). Empty string when no add-on services are enabled.

allocated_ipcs.description: IPcs currently consumed (allocated) for this member.

exceeding_capacity_type.description: Type of capacity the member is exceeding, if any (e.g. NONE, QPS, LPS, OBJECTS).

expiry_date.description: Expiry date of the bundle covering this member (YYYY-MM-DD), sourced from the IPc allocation bundle (tab.json).

hardware_model.description: Appliance hardware model of the member (e.g. IB-1425, TE-1425, IB-V1425).

host_name.description: The host name of the member.

ipc_auto_assigned.description: Whether the member's IPcs were auto-assigned by the system.

member_ref.description: Reference string for the member object. Allows filtering by member reference.

message.description: Optional human-readable message related to the member's status.

services.description: List of active services on this member with their current status. Each entry has service (e.g. DNS, DHCP) and status (e.g. WORKING, WARNING). Services with INACTIVE or UNKNOWN status are excluded.

status.description: Status of the member's IPc allocation (e.g. OK, UNKNOWN).

admin.description: Username of the administrator who performed the action.

event_type.description: Type of the IPc audit event. Possible values include: THRESHOLD_CHANGE, TOKEN_MODE_CHANGE, MODIFIED, CREATED, DELETED, CALLED, MESSAGE. THRESHOLD_CHANGE is reported for Grid changes to ipc_alerting_setting.credit_usage_threshold.

member.description: Host name of the member associated with the event, if applicable.

message.description: Human-readable description of the audit event.

new_value.description: New value after the change (empty string if not applicable).

previous_value.description: Previous value before the change (empty string if not applicable).

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp of the audit event (e.g. 2026-01-15T10:30:00). Supports range filtering with >= and <= operators for time-bounded queries.

token_name.description: Name of the affected IPc field or configuration item (e.g. credit_usage_threshold).

consumed.description: IPcs currently consumed for this type.

expiration_status.description: IPc expiration status: ACTIVE, EXPIRING_SOON, or EXPIRED. Derived from expiry_date using the same logic as the GM IPc Dashboard.

expiry_date.description: IPc validity expiration (TAB validUntil) as an ISO 8601 string. Same value across all rows. Empty for air-gapped grids with no TAB imported.

last_updated_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the last IPc stats refresh, as an ISO 8601 string.

limit.description: Licensed IPc capacity. NIOS IPc allocation is grid-wide rather than per-type, so all rows report the same value. Zero for air-gapped grids with no TAB imported.

overage.description: True when consumed exceeds the licensed limit, or when the grid is in overage mode per the IPc allocation upsize status.

percentage.description: Consumed as a percentage of limit (0-100+).

consumed.description: IPcs currently consumed for this type.

ipcs_over.description: How many IPcs over the limit this type is currently consuming (max(0, consumed - limit)).

last_updated_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the last IPc stats refresh, as an ISO 8601 string.

limit.description: Licensed IPc capacity. Grid-wide (same on every row). Zero for air-gapped grids with no TAB imported.

overage.description: True when this type is over its limit, or when the grid is in overage mode.

overage_status.description: Overage classification: NONE, OVERAGE (per-type), or GRID_OVERAGE (grid-wide signal).

rolling_average_3mo.description: 3-month rolling average IPc consumption. Currently grid-wide in the source data, so the same value appears on every row.

true_forward_history.description: List of past upsize events. Each entry has status, timestamp, and ipcs_added. NIOS source data exposes only the most recent event today, so this list is at most one entry.

air_gapped.description: True if the grid is not cloud-connected (cluster.token_grid_mode is False).

auth.description: Authentication mode: WEAK or STRONG. UNKNOWN when connectivity status is unavailable.

connectivity_status.description: Overall CSP connectivity status: CONNECTED, DISCONNECTED, or UNKNOWN. Sourced from the blox.noa connectivity API.

cp_noa_status.description: Connectivity status for the cp.noa.infoblox.com endpoint. CONNECTED, DISCONNECTED, or UNKNOWN.

csp_status.description: Connectivity status for the csp.infoblox.com endpoint. CONNECTED, DISCONNECTED, or UNKNOWN.

grpc_csp_status.description: Connectivity status for the grpc.csp.infoblox.com endpoint. CONNECTED, DISCONNECTED, or UNKNOWN.

last_sync_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful portal sync. Empty for air-gapped grids.

next_scheduled_sync.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the next expected portal sync. Computed as last_sync_time plus the polling interval (60s). Empty for air-gapped grids.

sync_mode.description: Sync mode: AUTO (daemon-driven). Empty for air-gapped grids.
